description: Roll back to the seed binding or restore from a backup. Before dispatch the runner checks database compatibility and reconciles actual Git/bd/process state, never dispatching on stale or ambiguous external state.
expected_observable: Database schema/version compatibility is checked first; restoring refuses incompatible state; Git/bd/process state is reconciled and evidence recorded before any dispatch; the seed binding and its recovery path remain available; ambiguous external effects park rather than dispatch.
